goal.name: Full Stack Development
goal.valid_for: HTML5/CSS3, modern JavaScript & TypeScript, React 19, Node.js 24 LTS, Express 5, PostgreSQL 17/18
goal.video_language_note: Composed from the FreeMentor Frontend, Backend and SQL roadmaps - English topic videos with Hindi alternatives (CodeWithHarry, Chai aur Code, Thapa Technical and others).
career_outcomes: Build responsive, accessible frontends with React and TypeScript
Build secure REST APIs with Node, Express and PostgreSQL
Connect frontend and backend into a full product
Test, containerise, deploy and document a full-stack app with CI/CD
Portfolio of 5 projects for Full Stack Developer roles
goal.resource_policy: Links only to free, legal sources (official docs, open-licence books, reputable free platforms, public YouTube videos). No copyrighted material re-hosted. YouTube videos are never paywalled or ad-gated.

estimated_hours.note: Video minutes are real YouTube durations with the +15% rule applied (see goal.last_link_check). Mocks and the revision allowance remain planning figures.

goal.prerequisite_note: A composed path. You can also follow the separate FreeMentor Frontend, Backend and SQL roadmaps for more depth on any part.
